name: Paco, Thirty Years of Queues

intro.text: Thirty years I've crossed this line, morning and evening. Through the closure stories, the gate, the euro, Brexit. I've seen everything a queue can do.
My team has waited in every queue with me. Patience is a weapon, you know.

win: Thirty years and you're the first to beat me before the barrier went up. Respect.
after: When the gate opened in 'eighty-five, my father walked me through and said: 'Remember this.' I remember it every morning, about ten past seven.
